args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified target** — the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy).
3. **Rolled back** — rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions; the rollback was verified.
4. **Opened incident** — created SEV2 **INC-0001** for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified target** — the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy).
3. **Rolled back** — rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions; the rollback was verified.
4. **Opened incident** — created SEV2 **INC-0001** for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.
